defects.title: Double click/tap on Next-round immediately pauses the new round
defects.repro: Finish a round, double-click (or double-tap) '다음 판'. Round 2 starts with the correct opposite starter (not skipped, single round id), but the second click lands on '일시정지', which occupies the same slot, so the fresh round is paused (pauseCause manual).
defects.expected: one activation -> one round; no accidental pause

defects.title: Resume resets roving selection and focus to cell 0
defects.repro: Start, focus cell 4, ArrowDown (selection 7), click 일시정지, click 게임 재개.
